boundary: Automated browser, service-worker and assistive-technology regressions do not substitute for installing and exercising the production PWA on physical iOS/iPadOS and Android devices. privacyBoundary: Public contract metadata must not include learner names, customer/site identifiers, email addresses, private screenshots, raw process data, backup content, filesystem/user paths or other personal/proprietary evidence.
